prompt:
Edit the attached paint_mask_guide.png exactly, a 1536x2048 transparent 3:4 atlas of 3 columns by FOUR rows of 512 square cells. Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the exact guide/edit target; image 2 design_reference.png is approved material/detail reference; image 3 icon_x8.png is binding original design and colour reference (magenta is background only).
Preserve every guide silhouette, position, size, orientation, gaps, and outline EXACTLY. Do not enlarge, move, redraw or redesign geometry. The unusual end-on and edge-on views must remain end-on and edge-on, not turn into full swords.
Rows 1-2 PAINT: paint only the grey objects with unlit base colour. Faithfully reproduce original MM9 Baselard: broad straight double-edged spear-point steel blade, thin muted-gold guard, compact dark-brown leather grip, small gold pommel, restrained MM6-MM8 inventory style. Follow reference detail scaled to each view, no embellishment. No lighting, shadows, AO, hot highlights or reflections. Steel pale grey with restrained fine surface texture, muted gold metal, dark brown wrapped leather.
Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK: same five silhouettes and exact geometry as above, filled FLAT PURE COLOURS. Every metal surface including blade, guard and pommel pure red #FF0000. Leather grip pure green #00FF00. If present cloth/hair pure blue #0000FF; matte nonmetal solids pure yellow #FFFF00; gems/glass/enamel/liquid pure black #000000. No texture, shading, outlines or antialiased colour blends inside mask regions. Every silhouette pixel exactly one material colour.
Layout of each two-row block: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty, as physically pictured in guide. Repeat same layout in lower two rows for masks. Column 3 of rows 2 and 4 stays completely transparent.
Output ONE PNG on genuine transparent alpha, 1536x2048 or nearest 3:4 size. Nothing outside silhouettes. No background, text, ground, outlines, glow, halo, sparkles. Paint sheet only.
